response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, cnt AS appearance_count, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g) AS ratio_to_average FROM g
